about_the_game:
About the Game:

You've run the temple.
You've stolen the jetpack.
You've crossed the road.

Have you got what it takes to survive the biggest challenge ever!?!

In Cartoon Survivor, you’ll face off against an unforgiving prehistoric world full of chaotic obstacles and feisty creatures at every turn. This 3D adventure runner is bursting with vibrant colours, wild action, and creatures of all shapes and sizes, from rampaging dinosaurs and towering mammoths to sneaky tigers and slithering snakes. Every step could be your last, so you’ll need your wits—and some seriously impressive parkour skills—to stay alive!

Take control of Doo Doo the Dodo’s successor, the Producer’s last shot at saving the show, in this fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping journey. Can you conquer the most insane obstacle courses ever designed and bring the Cartoon Survivors’ ratings back from the brink? Your survival is the only thing standing between this show and total cancellation.

Key Features:

  • Wild, Colourful World: Immerse yourself in a bright, cartoonish prehistoric landscape filled with danger, humour, and thrilling obstacles. Think you’ve seen it all? Think again.

  • Feisty Creatures: Face off against dinosaurs, mammoths, tigers, and snakes—all ready to make sure you don’t make it to the end. Dodge, jump, and glide your way to safety!

  • Crazy Obstacles: Run, leap, and glide through ever-changing environments and wild courses, each one more intense than the last. Can you handle the heart-pounding danger at every turn?

  • Unique Characters: Follow in the clumsy, courageous footsteps of the latest cartoon hero, stepping into the shoes of Doo Doo’s successor. The pressure's on to deliver or face extinction.

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Speed, reflexes, and quick thinking are your best friends. Every run is different, with ever-changing challenges designed to keep you on your toes. How long can you last in this colourful chaos?
